title: KCP endeavor_promotion_reconcile request (byom §16.3 five-fact recovery; R42 query, R40 terminalization)
description: Mutation (meta required; §11.2). Reads byom's own signed fact through external_command_result_query — the read-only recovery query a service reconciler may use, which cannot submit, terminalize, modify, or impersonate the original human — and commits the ONE machine row that fact authorizes: committed → byom_committed, absent → awaiting_principal (never a release), historically_fenced_absent → canceled with the slot released, non_reexecuting_tombstone → canceled with the slot released, unknown → ambiguous (conservative hold). Optionally terminalizes: the only liveness mutation available while the outcome is still ambiguous, admissible exactly where the descriptor's tombstone_verified row is and never over a verified committed result, and requiring the same source human freshly authenticated. Registry (governed_work_binding_v1): surface operator / human realm-owner principal only — never a service identity, session, assistant, or connector. Surface and actor kind are registry-enforced, not schema-expressible.

terminalize.description: Also call external_command_terminalize. Admissible while the outcome is still ambiguous (prepared, submitting, remote_unknown, awaiting_principal, ambiguous) and never over a verified committed result. It requires authentication_observation_ref: another principal, service, controller, or successor Participant cannot terminalize.

authentication_observation_ref.description: The fresh authentication of the SAME source human; required when terminalize is true.

reason.description: The tombstone reason the human gives for denying future execution.

args.description: Which formation, and whether to terminalize.

commandMeta.description: Command.meta (§11.2). Required on every mutation; idempotency keys are scoped by authenticated actor, operation, and realm; expected_revision drives optimistic concurrency (mismatch is stale-revision).

displayName.description: Display name bounded by the §11.8 cap of 256 Unicode scalar values, length-bounded again at admission.

ext.description: Extensions keyed by a reverse-domain namespace (§11.9); never interpreted as identity, authorization, budget, or policy.

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

protocolVersion.description: Negotiated KCP major.minor version; the initial protocol version is "0.1" (§11).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§11.8 rejects unsafe integers).

traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context traceparent header value; excluded from the idempotency request digest (§11.2).
